github_list_response_shape.note: bundle_url is an expiring signed URL; fixture redacts its query string.

compatible: GitHub stores a standard Sigstore bundle with dsseEnvelope.payloadType=application/vnd.in-toto+json.
The decoded payload is an in-toto Statement with _type, subject[], predicateType, and predicate.
GitHub accepts arbitrary predicateType text, so https://veriforge.dev/predicates/agent-execution/v0.1 fits the same statement slot.
subject.name and subject.digest.sha256 map directly to VeriForge execution-receipt.json subject and subjectForCommit().
Source provenance can be projected from SLSA buildDefinition.externalParameters.workflow and resolvedDependencies[].digest.gitCommit into VeriForge source.repository/ref/head_commit.
Cryptographic/non-user-controlled identity lives in verificationResult.signature.certificate and verifiedTimestamps, matching VeriForge assurance classes for provenance.signing=github_oidc.
gaps_or_followups: Modern repository attestations list API returns bundle_url, not an inline bundle; any importer must fetch/verify the bundle URL or use gh attestation verify output.

SLSA provenance uses buildDefinition/runDetails while VeriForge agent-execution uses source/task/agent/execution/evidence/policy/provenance; this is expected for GitHub provenance and does not require changing the custom predicate.
Do not treat statement.predicate alone as cryptographic truth; gh CLI warns only signature.certificate and verifiedTimestamps are non-user-controllable.
